phase: SEC-02-2 TECHNICAL CLAIM SCOPE + CITATION ALLOCATION REMEDIATION V1
principle: Frozen before remediation outputs and outcomes. A failed condition produces NO-GO; this gate is not amended to fit results.

conditions.condition: Frozen preflight covers Pilot #2, historical validators and renderer, frozen claims, realization v2.1, planner universe v2.1, drafting contract, source registry, audit and style contract; drift is 0 before implementation.
TDA-001 through TDA-006 each have one explicit root-cause classification and closure disposition.
C-004 and C-005 bind to wet-system scope through a general source-section ancestry rule, not a prose patch.
C-012 binds to repair-work scope or is removed from allocation with evidence; it cannot remain system-independent.
P0-008 retains the named crushed, squeezing and swelling rock classes plus tunnel-size dependency as structured source-backed conditions.
A new versioned claim states the source-backed 500 kg/m³ maximum and cement-type consequence without modifying the frozen allowlist.
Affected cement claims allocate citations only to a semantically matching, independently sufficient source; the misleading Tokluk-heading key is excluded without mutating the frozen registry.
C-002 has a structured acceptance-criterion realization whose subject is the 22.5/25.5 MPa table values, never the C25/30 designation.
Remediation is additive and versioned; frozen claims, allowlists, source registry, glosses, lexicons, plans, realization v2.1, renderer and validators remain byte-identical.
No generic gloss or lexicon entry is added or widened. New factual terms are source-owned structured claim data.
No claim-specific hard-coded prose branch exists in executable code; general scope, allocation and semantic-field rules operate on declarative records.
Negative fixtures reject all six old defective forms and wrong-source/unbound-scope variants deterministically.
Proof-only static containment covers every new or changed semantic field with false accepts 0, false rejects 0 and UNREALIZABLE leaks 0.

Proof-only feasibility covers all required topics, all mandatory scopes and qualifiers, the 500 kg/m³ maximum, named rock classes and valid citation allocations with an empty validator failure projection.
The remediation is structurally satisfiable under Book Style Contract v1 without generating or rendering prose.
OC-01 remains CLOSED and its controlled-prose test accepts only the immutable Pilot #2 Markdown.
Pilot #1 remains REJECTED; Pilot #2 remains PILOT_DRAFT_ACCEPTED, unreleased and byte-identical.
No validator, threshold, fixture or failure code is weakened, renamed or removed.
0 model calls, 0 generation, 0 draft renders, 0 retrieval calls, 0 Qdrant writes and 0 new corpus reads.
The phase suite and directly affected regressions pass; a full-suite gate is not required.

go_rule: CLOSED / GO only if all 20 conditions pass with frozen drift 0 and TDA-001 through TDA-006 closed.
